title: Egg Noodles with Broccoli, Tofu and Cashews
blurb: Tender egg noodles tossed with pan-fried tofu, steamed broccoli florets and roasted cashews in a ginger soy dressing.
steps: Drain the tofu and pat dry with kitchen paper, then cut into bite-sized cubes.
Peel and finely grate the ginger, then whisk together with the soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Bring a large pan of water to the boil, add the egg noodles and cook according to packet instructions until tender, then drain well.
Meanwhile, heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan or wok over medium-high heat and fry the tofu cubes for 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden on all sides.
Steam the broccoli florets in a steamer basket or colander set over simmering water for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Return the drained noodles to their pan and add the tofu, broccoli, cashews and ginger dressing.
Toss everything together gently over low heat for a minute until well combined and warmed through, then serve.
